purpose: Lays down and replaces core on a seeded Squire owner's folder through the real install path, and compares the folder's hashes before and after.
title: Core replacement leaves the Squire owner's folder unchanged

testCases.description: Core is laid down, laid down again and replaced with a different core through core/tools/lay-down.py; the core matches each release file for file and the owner's folder is byte for byte the same each time, down to modification times and inodes.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/core-owner-split.test.js::laying core down again or replacing it with a different core leaves the owner folder byte for byte the same
